crossRefs.note: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
how in much proof of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their…
I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have…
having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows…
hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints,
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward…
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind…
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

translations.web: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
translations.bsb: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
translations.kjv: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
